section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.3) describes the Subjective Happiness Scale, a 4-item instrument with a 7-point Likert-type response scale used to measure subjective happiness. The scale includes absolute self-ratings, peer-relative ratings, and characteristic descriptions, with higher scores indicating greater happiness. The section reports good internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .89) for both US and non-US samples, indicating reliable measurement across different populations.
